unit: MIT HEALS (Health and Life Sciences Collaborative)
notes: MIT HEALS is an Institute-wide funding and programs collaborative (seed grants, fellowships, cross-departmental initiatives like Hood Hub and the Fairbairn Menstruation Science Fund), not a PI-led lab itself -- it funds projects led by PIs in their home departments across MIT and Mass General Brigham. No PI, team or people directory page exists on the site; general contact is mit-heals@mit.edu. Recorded empty per the project's cross-cutting-hub convention (same as MGAIC, CMSA, HDSI).
